def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]

    cols = len(grid[0])

        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == color]
        
        # Find contiguous same-color cells sharing r-c (diagonal) or r+c (antidiagonal)
        rc_groups = {}
        sc_groups = {}
        for r, c in cells:
            dc = r - c
            sc = r + c
            if dc not in rc_groups:
                rc_groups[dc] = []
            if sc not in sc_groups:
                sc_groups[sc] = []
            rc_groups[dc].append((r, c))
